title: Appeal Decisions and Employer Benefit Charging Relief
content:
An appeal decision can relieve an Employer Benefit Charging position. A decision on the employer benefit charge docket, or a separation decision on appeal that finds a relief ground for this employer, relieves the position from the decision's mailing date.

## Authorization

The position is relieved on appeal only when the appeal concerning it is decided with outcome reversed; a decision affirming the charges leaves the position chargeable and may be appealed to the Board of Review. The outcome is read from the Department's appeal record for the determination concerning this position, never from the caller's description of the decision.

| Recorded appeal outcome | Position | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| Reversed | Relieved from the decision's mailing date | Charges already posted within the relief's scope are credited back with credit reason appeal reversal |
| Affirmed | Stays chargeable; the decision may be appealed to the Board of Review | None under this rule |

## Credit

Charges already posted within the relief's scope are credited back with credit reason appeal reversal.

## Basis Q&A

*An appeal on the position is still pending. Is the position relieved?* No. Relief on appeal follows only a decision with outcome reversed.
